title.english: The Mountain on the Way Home

pairs.target: gōnggòng chē líkāi fēng zhàn shí , tǎ wéi méiyǒu zuò kàochuāng nà yìbiān .
pairs.english: When the public cart left Wind Trestle, Tavi wasn't in the seat by the window.
pairs.hanzi: 公共车离开风栈时，塔维没有坐靠窗那一边。

pairs.target: píng tiáo shàng yuán liú le chuāng wèi , zuòxià qián , yígè bào háizi de nǚrén wèn néngfǒu huàn , háizi méi zuò guò zhè duàn lù , zhèng bā zhe chēyán wàng .
pairs.english: His voucher reserved that seat, but a woman with a child asked to swap before he sat; the child hadn't traveled this road and was peering over the cart edge.
pairs.hanzi: 凭条上原留了窗位，坐下前，一个抱孩子的女人问能否换，孩子没坐过这段路，正扒着车沿望。

pairs.target: tā dāying yǐhòu , ruǎn héng zhī wǎng lǐ nuó le nuó , ràng tā bǎ bāo gē wěn , méi wèn shìbushì yòu jiāng hǎokàn de rànggěi biérén .
pairs.english: When he agreed, Ruan Heng merely moved inward to make room for his bag, without asking if he'd given the view away again.
pairs.hanzi: 他答应以后，阮衡只往里挪了挪，让他把包搁稳，没问是不是又将好看的让给别人。

pairs.target: chē guò zhuǎnwān , háizi guǒrán jiào qǐlái , shuō shān zěnme hái zài hòumiàn .
pairs.english: Rounding the bend, the child cried out: why were mountains still behind them?
pairs.hanzi: 车过转弯，孩子果然叫起来，说山怎么还在后面。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi huítóu , zhǐjiàn fēng zhàn wūdǐng yǐ cáng zhù dàbàn , mùcáo nà tóu shǎnguò yì diǎnliàng shuǐ , jiēzhe yě bèi shù dǎngzhù .
pairs.english: Looking back, Tavi saw most Wind Trestle roofs hidden, a gleam of flume water then trees hiding that too.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维回头，只见风栈屋顶已藏住大半，木槽那头闪过一点亮水，接着也被树挡住。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng gàosù háizi shān bìng méi gēnzhe zǒu , huàdàozuǐbiān què tíng le , zìjǐ cóngqián zuòchē shí yě cháng juéde shānyuè zǒu yuè duō , méi shuí zhàn zài pángbiān yízuòzuò tì tā bānkāi .
pairs.english: He started to explain to the child that mountains didn't follow, then stopped; he had once felt every journey brought more mountains too, without anyone moving each aside for him.
pairs.hanzi: 他想告诉孩子山并没跟着走，话到嘴边却停了，自己从前坐车时也常觉得山越走越多，没谁站在旁边一座座替他搬开。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng shàngchē méiduōjiǔ biàn shuìzháo le , tóu wǎngqián yì zāi , zìjǐ jīngxǐng yíxià , yòu shuì .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng fell asleep soon after boarding, head dipping forward, briefly waking, then sleeping again.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡上车没多久便睡着了，头往前一栽，自己惊醒一下，又睡。

pairs.target: nà tà bàogào bào zài huáilǐ , shǒubèi de jiùshāng xiàng yìtiáo dàn xiàn .
pairs.english: The report rested in his arms, an old hand scar a pale line.
pairs.hanzi: 那沓报告抱在怀里，手背的旧伤像一条淡线。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dìyīcì méi chèn tā xǐng shí zài wèn yìhuí wéi lǎoshī huì wèn shénme , zhī shēnshǒu jiāngyào huá xià de zhǐ jiǎo tuīhuíqù .
pairs.english: For once Tavi didn't ask again what Vey might ask while he was awake, only tucked the slipping paper corner back.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维第一次没趁他醒时再问一回维老师会问什么，只伸手将要滑下的纸角推回去。

alignment.english: tucked the slipping paper corner back

pairs.target: wǔqián tíng zài yíchù huàn mǎpéng , chēfū shuō zhǐnéng xiē dào xià yìkǒu shuǐ hēwán , bié qù yuǎnchù mǎi rèfàn .
pairs.english: Before noon they stopped at a horse-changing shed. The driver said rest only until he had drunk his next water: no distant hot-food shopping.
pairs.hanzi: 午前停在一处换马棚，车夫说只能歇到下一口水喝完，别去远处买热饭。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi cóng bāo lǐ náchū zǎo bèi de bǐng , fēngěi ruǎn héng .
pairs.english: Tavi shared the prepared flatbread from his bag with Ruan Heng.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维从包里拿出早备的饼，分给阮衡。

pairs.target: bǐng bèi mùtiáo yāliè yìjiǎo , xiè luò zài kù shàng , tā suǒxìng bāikāi chī , fāxiàn lǐtou jìng hái jiá zhe yìdiǎn suāncài , shì fànpù lǎobǎn zǎochén bāo de .
pairs.english: The flatbread had been crushed at one corner by his wooden strip; crumbs fell on his trousers. Breaking it to eat, he found sour greens inside, packed by the eatery owner that morning.
pairs.hanzi: 饼被木条压裂一角，屑落在裤上，他索性掰开吃，发现里头竟还夹着一点酸菜，是饭铺老板早晨包的。

pairs.target: pángbiān yígè nánrén wèn tāmen cóng nǎ tóu lái , yòu wèn xuégōng shìbushì rújīn yě jiào zěnyàng gěi méi pái xiānhòu .
pairs.english: A man nearby asked their starting point, then whether the academy now taught assigning coal priority.
pairs.hanzi: 旁边一个男人问他们从哪头来，又问学宫是不是如今也教怎样给煤排先后。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng tīng chū tā dài diǎn cì , méiyǒu duān zhe lǎoshī de yàngzi , zhī shuō xuégōng jiào dé le bùshǎo , zhēn dào lùshang , méi hái dé yìchē chē kàn .
pairs.english: Hearing the barb, Ruan Heng didn't adopt a teacher's manner in answering him: the academy taught plenty, but on roads coal still needed checking cart by cart.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡听出他带点刺，没有端着老师的样子，只说学宫教得了不少，真到路上，煤还得一车车看。

pairs.target: nánrén biàn jiǎng zìjǐ líncūn bèi nuó guò bān , méi shuō quán shì nǎbiān de cuò , zhī shuō huíqù tóng qīzǐ jiěshì shí , tā zuìxiān wèn de shì wèishénme biérén dōu néng zǎo zhīdào .
pairs.english: The man described his neighboring village's rescheduled slot, not blaming one side entirely; his wife's first question had been why everyone else could know sooner.
pairs.hanzi: 男人便讲自己邻村被挪过班，没说全是哪边的错，只说回去同妻子解释时，她最先问的是为什么别人都能早知道。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tīng zhe , méi jiāng fēng zhàn nà zhāng xīn biǎo ná chūlái zuòdá .
pairs.english: Tavi listened without producing Wind Trestle's new chart as an answer.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维听着，没将风栈那张新表拿出来作答。

pairs.target: nánrén shuō de shì lìng yíchù zhuǎn huò diǎn , méi rén zhīdào tāmen nàlǐ shíjì tiē guò shénme .
pairs.english: The man meant another transfer point; none knew what it actually posted.
pairs.hanzi: 男人说的是另一处转货点，没人知道他们那里实际贴过什么。

pairs.target: tā wènqīng shì nǎ duàn lù , jiāng míngzì jì zài bàogào wài de yì xiǎozhāng zhǐ shàng ; ruǎn héng shuō huí suǒ lǐ kě dìguòqù wèn , bù xǔnuò jīnrì biàn tì shuí gǎi huí .
pairs.english: Tavi clarified the road and noted its name outside the report; Ruan Heng said he could pass an inquiry on at the office, not promise to reverse it today.
pairs.hanzi: 他问清是哪段路，将名字记在报告外的一小张纸上；阮衡说回所里可递过去问，不许诺今日便替谁改回。

pairs.target: chē zàiqǐ xíng , shānshì jiànjiàn kāichū yìtiáo cháng fèng , yuǎnchù yíliè báiqiáng guà zài pō shàng , xiàmiàn de tītián fàn zhe qiǎn huīlǜ .
pairs.english: Moving again, the mountains opened a long gap: distant white walls hung on a slope over pale gray-green terraces.
pairs.hanzi: 车再起行，山势渐渐开出一条长缝，远处一列白墙挂在坡上，下面的梯田泛着浅灰绿。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bìngbùzhīdào nà shì nǎ zuò chéng , zhǐjiàn yìtiáo jí xì de lù shēn dào qiángbiān , zài gèng gāochù duàn jìn yún lǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi didn't know which city it was; a fine road reached the wall and disappeared higher in cloud.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维并不知道那是哪座城，只见一条极细的路伸到墙边，在更高处断进云里。

pairs.target: tā xiǎngqǐ shí tīng shuǐmiàn shàng de wūdǐng , tóngyàng shì rén zhù zhe de dìfāng , què bùnéng ná tóngyì bǎ chǐ qù liáng tāmen lí shìjiè yǒu duō yuǎn .
pairs.english: He recalled Shiting's roofs over water: both inhabited places, their distance from the world impossible to measure with one ruler.
pairs.hanzi: 他想起石汀水面上的屋顶，同样是人住着的地方，却不能拿同一把尺去量它们离世界有多远。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn dǐdá dìnghǎo de kèdiàn , zhǔrén xiān kàn píng tiáo , zài jiào rén lǐng tāmen dào hòuyuàn .
pairs.english: At dusk they reached the booked inn. Checking the voucher, the host sent them to the rear courtyard.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚抵达订好的客店，主人先看凭条，再叫人领他们到后院。

pairs.target: búshì fēng zhàn nà jiān chuáng , yě méiyǒu xuégōng chuāng biān nàgēn jiù shéng , wūlǐ liǎngzhāng zhǎi chuáng zhōngjiān bǎi yìzhāng xiǎozhuō .
pairs.english: Not Wind Trestle's bed or the academy window's old cord: two narrow beds with a small table between.
pairs.hanzi: 不是风栈那间床，也没有学宫窗边那根旧绳，屋里两张窄床中间摆一张小桌。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng bāo dǎkāi , zhī qǔ xǐshù de dōngxī , méi bǎ suǒyǒu xìn zài tān yíbiàn .
pairs.english: Tavi opened his bag for washing things only, not spreading every letter again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将包打开，只取洗漱的东西，没把所有信再摊一遍。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng xiàlóu wèn míngzǎo kāichē de shíchén , huílái shí duōduān yìwǎn rètāng , shuō diànlǐ jīnrì zhī shèng zhège , bié dīng zhe tā děng chū yíkuài ròu .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng went downstairs to ask tomorrow's departure time and returned with an extra bowl of hot soup: it was all the inn had left, don't stare expecting meat to appear.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡下楼问明早开车的时辰，回来时多端一碗热汤，说店里今日只剩这个，别盯着它等出一块肉。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiēguò lái , jìng zài wǎndǐ lāo dào bànkuài luóbo , dìgěi tā kàn .
pairs.english: Tavi found half a radish at the bottom and showed him.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维接过来，竟在碗底捞到半块萝卜，递给他看。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng shuō nà shì tā yǎnjīng hǎo , zìjǐ nà wǎn méi kànjiàn , biàn shēn kuàizi lái fēn .
pairs.english: Good eyes, Ruan Heng said: he hadn't seen one in his bowl, reaching with his chopsticks to share.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡说那是他眼睛好，自己那碗没看见，便伸筷子来分。

pairs.target: chuāngwài yǒurén xièxià chēlún biān guà de kōng shuǐtǒng , tǒng dǐ pèng dì , shēngxiǎng tóng xià róng nàwǎn jìnmén shí hěn xiàng .
pairs.english: Outside, someone lowered an empty bucket hung by a cart wheel. Its thump sounded like Xiarong coming in that evening.
pairs.hanzi: 窗外有人卸下车轮边挂的空水桶，桶底碰地，声响同夏绒那晚进门时很像。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi hēwán tāng , qǐshēn jiāng liǎngzhī wǎn dōu sòng xiàlóu , fàngdào lǎobǎn yǎnqián cái huílái .
pairs.english: Finishing his soup, Tavi took both bowls downstairs and put them before the host before returning.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维喝完汤，起身将两只碗都送下楼，放到老板眼前才回来。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng wèn zěnme qù nàme jiǔ , tā shuō shù le yíbiàn , wūlǐ xiān jìng le yíxià , jiēzhe liǎng rén dōu xiào le .
pairs.english: Asked why so long, he said he had counted. After a moment's quiet, both laughed.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡问怎么去那么久，他说数了一遍，屋里先静了一下，接着两人都笑了。
